---
title: "Runtime and Rating Analysis"
---

```{python}
#| include: false
#| warning: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

```

This page analyzes the runtimes and ratings of the 104 well-known films. 

@fig-scatter-run below summarizes and visualizes this relationship, where runtime is given in minutes and rating is the public rating from IMDB between 0 and 10.

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-scatter-run
#| fig-cap: "Scatter plot of runtime (x-axis) against rating (y-axis)"

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("Rating (0-10)")
plt.show()
```

@tbl-decade below provides the average IMDB ratings of films in this dataset by decade.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| label: tbl-decade
#| fig-cap: "Table of the average IMDB ratings of films by decade"

films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
